title: Harry S Probable NDE 5267
content: Out of body experience. My soul or spirit made its way through mist and a tunnel. I arrived at the end, facing a solid oak door. Next to the oak door was a spirit, shadow figure who knew me really well. No words were spoken or exchanged. All communication was through mind communication between us. The oak door opened for me. I peered through. It was a beautiful place with music that sounded peaceful and blissful. I was feeling euphoric and wanted to step through. I was reassured by the spirit to go through the door. 'You deserve this. You can go back in any year you wish or into any being.' It felt awesome and overwhelming. I was so close to going through the door, but stopped. A sudden thought came into my mind. I can't leave yet. I have not prepared for this. I have to sort things out for my family. An urgency took over me and the spirit reassured me. It said, 'If you want to go back, leave now. But you will have to fight.' As soon as I blinked my eyes, I was transported into another dimension and another world. All I will say on this is that it was a horrible, dark and desolate place where I was alone. It stank. There were fires burning with grey clouds of burning rubber. All my feelings and thoughts were filled with the most fearful emotions I have ever experienced. This is where the fight began. Upon returning to my body, which felt like going back into a shell, in a blink of the eye, I was met by another being who gave me intense feelings of reassurance and touched me on my shoulder. I looked into her eyes and then I feel asleep. I awoke to find myself talking to a family member.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Made its way through mist and a tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: A spirit/shadow figure next to a solid oak door who knew the experiencer well; later, another being (female) who touched the experiencer's shoulder and gave reassurance.

environment.environment_other_detail: Solid oak door; "beautiful place with music" beyond the door; later "another dimension" described as horrible, dark, desolate, stinking, with fires and grey clouds of burning rubber.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Door/threshold scene; transport to a dark desolate realm; "fight" to return; being touched on shoulder upon return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: After the door/threshold and choosing to return, the experiencer reports being transported to another dark realm where a "fight" began, before returning to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A door/threshold with a spirit telling the experiencer: "You deserve this. You can go back in any year you wish or into any being." After choosing to return, immediate transport to a horrible dark realm described as part of a required "fight" to return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'You deserve this. You can go back in any year you wish or into any being.' 'If you want to go back, leave now. But you will have to fight.'
